standards.description: Identify the main idea of a short passage and locate the detail that directly answers a stated question about it.
standards.ccssText: Determine the central idea of a text and identify explicitly stated details that support or elaborate on it. (College Board: Information and Ideas, Central ideas and details)

standards.description: Choose the answer that most logically completes an unfinished line of reasoning in a passage, based only on the stated evidence.
standards.ccssText: Draw reasonable inferences from a text, selecting the conclusion that logically follows from the information provided. (College Board: Information and Ideas, Inferences)
standards.worksheetReason: SAT adaptive module split: Tier 1 matches Module 1 and easier Module 2 difficulty; Tier 2 matches harder Module 2 difficulty.

standards.description: Select the quotation or finding that most directly supports or weakens a stated claim or hypothesis.

standards.worksheetReason: SAT adaptive module split: Tier 1 matches Module 1 and easier Module 2 difficulty; Tier 2 matches harder Module 2 difficulty.

standards.description: Use data from a table or graph to complete a statement or support a claim made in an accompanying passage.

standards.worksheetReason: SAT adaptive module split: Tier 1 matches Module 1 and easier Module 2 difficulty; Tier 2 matches harder Module 2 difficulty.

standards.description: Choose the most precise word or phrase to complete a short passage, using context clues and tone.

standards.worksheetReason: SAT adaptive module split: Tier 1 matches Module 1 and easier Module 2 difficulty; Tier 2 matches harder Module 2 difficulty.

standards.description: Describe the function of a sentence within a passage or the overall purpose and structure of a short text.

standards.description: Choose the transition word or phrase that most logically connects two sentences or ideas in a passage.
